title: CP Review

matrix.title: Per-Item Yield
matrix.hint: Q1/Q2/Q3 yield for each wafer × electrical item; scroll horizontally. Red marks a low-yield item, so a drifting parameter is pinpointed.

selectLotPrompt: Select a lot to view review results, or upload data first.
q2NotConfigured: If Q2 rules are configured, click 'Run Review' above to recalculate. If it still shows N/A, no Q2 rules exist for this product.
notReviewedHint: This lot hasn't been reviewed yet, so Q1 / Q2 / Q3 yields are not shown. Click "Run Review" at the top right to calculate them.

detail.title: Review Details
detail.aiSummaryAllPass: Wafer {{waferId}} Bin1 Yield {{yield}}%. All dies passed. {{paramCount}} electrical parameters measured.
detail.aiSummaryWithFail: Wafer {{waferId}} Bin1 Yield {{yield}}%. {{failCount}} fail die(s) detected. {{paramCount}} electrical parameters measured.

specSource.title: Which spec does this page read?
lines: Yields come from each die's measurement checked against the Q1 / Q2 / Q3 limits in Review Rules.
Where Q1 has no rule, the CP file's own limits are used instead.
— Packaging specs from Spec Management are not used here

judge.title: Judgement
judge.threshold: Thresholds: PASS at {{pass}}% or above, WARN at {{warn}}% or above, HOLD below
judge.advisory: The system flags against the rules; a person makes the final call.
judge.notReviewed: This lot has not been reviewed yet — the verdict above is a live reading. Run 執行審核 to fill the Q1 / Q2 columns.
